context: Evaluates whether the candidate correctly uses the useUpdateItem mutation hook from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce. Tests knowledge of the hook's item context pattern, correct argument passing for quantity updates, and the package's built-in behavior of delegating removal when quantity drops below 1.

checklist.name: Uses useUpdateItem hook
checklist.description: The component imports and calls useUpdateItem from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce, not a generic PUT fetch.

checklist.name: Item context initialization
checklist.description: The useUpdateItem hook is initialized with the line item as the item context (passed to the hook call, not the mutation function).

checklist.name: Passes quantity correctly
checklist.description: The mutation function receives an object with the new quantity value from the input.

checklist.name: Input initialized from lineItem
checklist.description: The numeric input is initialized with lineItem.quantity as its default value.

checklist.name: Zero quantity behavior
checklist.description: The component does not block quantity 0 — it passes it to the hook, which handles removal internally.
